core_obligations: Prove (1) by combining the right-exact twisted sequence with the assumed universal exactness (proof lines 2772-2776).
Read (2) off from (1) applied to the syzygy sequences K^i -> M^i -> K^{i+1} (proof lines 2779-2782).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that in a universally exact sequence L -> M -> N the image K = Im(M -> N) has K -> N universally injective, and that any universally exact complex splits into universally exact short exact sequences (statement lines 2759-2768). Part (1) is proved with a displayed tensor argument: for any module T the sequence L tensor T -> M tensor T -> K tensor T -> 0 is exact by right exactness, while the assumption gives exactness of L tensor T -> M tensor T -> N tensor T, and combining the two yields injectivity of K tensor T -> N tensor T; part (2) is then read off by applying part (1) to the syzygy sequences of the complex (proof lines 2771-2782). The level is H3: the tensor-level verification is written out in full and the reduction of (2) to (1) is explicit.
